question: What power is attributed to the ucchiṣṭa-preceded goddess Mātaṅgī?
premises: Mātaṅgī is identified with the ucchiṣṭa-preceded form.
She is described as giving all accomplishments.
The statement presents her as an object of teaching.
inference: The ucchiṣṭa-preceded Mātaṅgī is presented as the bestower of all siddhis.
plain_english: And indeed tell of Mātaṅgī, preceded by ucchiṣṭa, who grants all accomplishments.
